item.title: Destructuring & the Spread Operator
item.description: Let’s talk about syntactic sugar that genuinely makes your day better. Before ES6, extracting properties from objects felt like typing the same word over and over again until your fingers hurt: const title = article.title; const author = article.author; const date = article.date; Today, we have Destructuring and the Spread operator (...). Once you start using them, going back feels almost impossible. :v 1. Object Destructuring Instead of manually pulling keys one by one, unpack them directly:
